metadata.title: SAR - Sending Domain Without DMARC
metadata.remarks: Assessment result identifying an institutional sending domain that does not publish a DMARC policy, contrary to the DNS Secure Email SSPP.

findings.title: Sending Domain Missing DMARC
findings.description: An institutional email-sending domain does not publish a DMARC policy as required by the DNS Secure Email SSPP.

associated-risk.title: Email Spoofing and Brand Impersonation
associated-risk.description: Without DMARC, unauthorized senders may impersonate institutional domains, leading to phishing, fraud, and reputational harm.

remediations.title: Implement DMARC on Sending Domain
remediations.description: Publish and enforce a DMARC policy for the identified sending domain in accordance with institutional DNS Secure Email requirements.

tasks.title: Publish DMARC Record
tasks.description: Publish a DMARC record with enforcement for the sending domain and validate alignment with SPF and DKIM.
